instruction: Look at freecad_task-10_input.step in FreeCAD. Use the Part Design workbench throughout; activate the Body, create new sketches on the required faces or planes, and complete all fused features in the same Body using GUI additive and subtractive features. Turn the plain disk into a four-spoke handwheel while keeping the 120 mm outside diameter. Cut a center through bore of diameter 22 mm. Cut four rounded rectangular through windows between the spokes, each total length 42 mm and width 16 mm, centered on radius 36 mm at angles 45, 135, 225, and 315 degrees; orient each window tangentially to the circle. Cut eight vertical through bolt holes of diameter 6 mm at radius 47 mm every 45 degrees. Add and fuse a top hub cylinder of diameter 36 mm and height 8 mm centered on the bore, while keeping the bore open through the hub. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-10_output.step using only GUI operations; external scripts are not allowed.
